question: What share of the vote will Vox win in Spain's November 29, 2026 general election?

calls.reasoning: Poll average early Nov 2026 ~19.5% (Colmena), range of ~18 polls 18.6-20.2%, trend up. Vox has been overstated by polls in Apr-2019 and 2023 generals by ~1.5pt, understated in Nov-2019, so I shade the median slightly to 19.3 and keep a SD of ~1.8. Polymarket: <16% at ~1%, >=22% at ~7% (thin, ~3k volume each, same vote-share contract terms) — consistent with my median, slightly tighter tails. No mechanism for leaving the 10-30 range.
calls.dossier:
- Wikipedia polling table (accessed 2026-11-03): ~18 national polls 1 Oct–1 Nov 2026 have Vox 18.6–20.2%: SocioMétrica 19.1 (to 1 Nov), Sigma Dos 19.3 (29–30 Oct), Target Point 19.9, EM-Analytics 19.2, NC Report 19.3, Sondaxe 19.2, Hamalgama 19.9, The Objective 20.2, PSOE internal 20.0, Winston 19.2, Ateneo del Dato 19.8, IMOP 20.0 (13–16 Oct), SocioMétrica 18.6 (to 25 Oct).
- Colmena de Datos average, 1st week of Nov 2026: PP 31.4 (-1.2), PSOE 26.3 (+0.6), Vox 19.5 (+1.3 vs October), Sumar 6.4, Podemos 2.7, SALF 1.8. Vox gaining at PP's expense; PSOE gaining during the campaign; momentum after the Urda rail accident.
- Another reported 16-pollster average puts Vox at 18.7% (search snippet, Infobae/El Independiente, Oct 2026).
- Vox internal poll (The Objective, 1 Nov 2026): 20.2%, 67–71 seats.
- Democrata.es (post-Urda): five polls average Vox ~19.5%, 67 seats; Vox reportedly growing in Catalonia.
- Past results: 2015/2016 0.2%, Apr-2019 10.3%, Nov-2019 15.1%, 2023 12.4%.
- Polling error reference class (Vox in general elections, from memory): final polls ~12 vs 10.3 actual (Apr 2019), ~13.5 vs 15.1 (Nov 2019), ~14 vs 12.4 (2023). Errors of ~1.5–2pt in both directions; overstated 2 of 3 times.
- Status quo: the poll average roughly holds through election day.
- Resolves off the proclaimed national share of valid votes (including blank ballots) for Congress, per JEC/Interior Ministry, not off seat counts or polls.
- Event window: single election day, 2026-11-29; as of 2026-11-03 the vote is 26 days away (campaign ongoing).
- Searched but not found: CIS November estimate; verified regional-election poll-vs-result data for Vox in 2025–26.

calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on the facts. The quoted averages (18.7 / 19.1 / 19.5) differ by date (20 Oct vs early Nov) and reflect a real upward trend, not a conflict, so the current anchor is ~19.1-19.5. The historical error pattern is from all three runs' memory and was not re-verified (no web access on this run); it is kept as stated, with the uncertainty that implies. Carrying forward the runs' shared SD of ~1.8 and median of ~19.3; tails checked against the thin Polymarket threshold contracts.
